lesson: The number of windows is not the controlling variable. Against translates only the relative spread of heights counts (L/T >= eta log(T/2pi)/pi), and adjacent windows cost about 0.36 real conditions each, not 30. STRATEGY 4.0 (b) should speak of conditions at heights whose ratios differ from 1 by more than eta log T/pi, not of sqrt(T)/log T windows.
